claude.performance_metric: Nasdaq delisting effective April 28, 2023 (moved to OTC Pink); revenue grew $876.7M→$1,145.9M FY2021-FY2023
claude.rationale: p5 is coded 1 because the slice documents a realized process/organization fracture: management repeatedly concluded internal controls were not effective (FY2021-FY2023) due to material weaknesses, expressly citing that "Senior Management failed to set an appropriate tone at the top sufficient to ensure a culture of compliance" — an operations-versus-people/management/culture breakdown, compounded by a restatement of FY2020 statements, an ~8-month-late FY2022 report, an SEC inquiry, and Nasdaq delisting. p4 is coded 0 because the slice documents product/operational activity growing coherently (increased hydraulic fracturing and coiled tubing driving revenue up to $1,145.9M) with no documented product/process incoherence. t2 is 0 because no incompatible value-capture logics are documented; the business made additive acquisitions and grew revenue. t1 is uncertain because the slice contains no controlling-intent/archetype characterization of the underlying combination.

grok.performance_metric: no divestiture; Nasdaq delisted Apr 2023; net income returned FY2023
grok.rationale: The slice documents continued operation with revenue rising from $876.7M (FY2021) to $1,145.9M (FY2023), driven by hydraulic fracturing and coiled tubing activity, plus further bolt-on acquisitions rather than any product-line or operations incoherence, so p4_pathway is 0. Documented problems are persistent ICFR material weaknesses, tone-at-the-top/compliance failures, a restatement, late FY2022 20-F, SEC inquiry, and Nasdaq delisting—governance/control and listing events, not a realized fracture of operations integration against people/management/culture—so p5_pathway is 0.
